definition_scope: Acute inflammation or infection centered on the palatine tonsils; generic pharyngitis and streptococcal pharyngitis remain distinct.
label: Acute tonsillitis

definition_scope: Acute common cold; not automatically equivalent to every use of nasopharyngitis or nonspecific upper respiratory infection.
label: Common cold

definition_scope: Generic acute rhinosinusitis episode; chronic, recurrent and sinus-localized subtypes are excluded.
label: Acute rhinosinusitis

definition_scope: Generic acute middle-ear infection; otitis externa, otitis media with effusion, chronic and purulent-only subtypes remain distinct.
label: Acute otitis media

definition_scope: Patient-reported pain or soreness localized to the throat.
label: Sore throat

definition_scope: Pain or clinically important difficulty when swallowing.
label: Painful swallowing

definition_scope: Visual examination finding of red and swollen palatine tonsils.
label: Red and swollen tonsils

definition_scope: White patches or pus-filled spots observed on the tonsils; does not by itself establish streptococcal etiology.
label: Tonsillar exudate or white patches

definition_scope: Patient-reported nasal discharge without an etiologic interpretation.
label: Runny nose

definition_scope: Pain, tenderness or pressure localized around the cheeks, eyes or forehead.
label: Facial pain or pressure

definition_scope: Patient-reported reduction in sense of smell.
label: Reduced sense of smell

definition_scope: Green or yellow nasal mucus; not interpreted by itself as proof of bacterial disease.
label: Green or yellow nasal discharge

definition_scope: Fluid or pus draining from the ear; external-ear and chronic causes remain differential considerations.
label: Otorrhea

definition_scope: Fluid or mucus affecting the middle ear; this finding is not specific for acute infection and overlaps with effusion.
label: Middle-ear fluid

definition_scope: Patient-reported or observed reduction in hearing.
label: Hearing difficulty
